analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported its highest-ever consolidated annual revenue, EBITDA, and PAT for FY26, crossing the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone. The company's order book position as of March 31, 2026, stood at approximately INR 2,000 million. Goldiam expanded its domestic B2C lab-grown diamond brand, ORIGEM, to 24 operational stores across 12 cities and targets 45 to 50 stores by exit FY27. Management highlighted that its hybrid casting method in the U.S. renders the company tariff-agnostic and helps improve gross margin profile.

guidance.claim: Goldiam targets double-digit overall growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: Goldiam is targeting an exit revenue of about INR 7 crores per month for its ORIGEM business in FY27.
guidance.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

guidance.claim: The company expects to have 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores operational by September 2026.
guidance.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

guidance.claim: Goldiam aims to reach around 45 to 50 stores for ORIGEM by exit FY27.
guidance.quote: We hope to have around 45 to 50 stores by exit FY '27.

guidance.claim: Goldiam expects its order book of about ₹ 2,000 million to be executed within the next three to four months.
guidance.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

guidance.claim: The company expects to potentially double its B2B business within three to five years.
guidance.quote: Within 3-5 years also we should expect to be at the number you just talked about.

guidance.claim: Management expects Origem stores to maintain store-level gross margins in the 38% to 42% range.
guidance.quote: Yes, currently slightly higher than that, but yes, we will be in the 38%-42% range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand scenario continues to look positive, particularly in lab-grown diamond studded jewelry.
demand_outlook.quote: So yes, the demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are moving down in gold caratage to mitigate higher raw material costs.
demand_outlook.quote: In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees the demand scenario remaining robust.
demand_outlook.quote: With these changes in mind, we see the demand scenario remaining robust.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volumes increased for Goldiam during Q4 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Volumes have certainly gone up in Q4 for us.

demand_outlook.claim: Realisations for lab-grown diamond jewellery remain at a premium compared to mined diamond jewellery due to higher caratage sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Realisations for LGD jewellery continue to be at a premium to Mined Diamond jewellery for the company due to sales of higher caratage jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated Q3 FY26 revenue grew by 18% supported by demand in the US market.
demand_outlook.quote: Passive demand in the U.S. during Q3 helped Goldiam post consolidated revenue growth of 18%.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for lab-grown diamond jewelry has grown dramatically across major international and domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So, I may want to add to this, Mr. Anubhav, that the demand for lab-grown diamond jewelry has increased dramatically all over the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports comprised 90.5% of overall export sales in Q3 FY26 compared to 80% in Q3 FY25.
demand_outlook.quote: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports contributed to 90.5% to the overall export-sales mix during Q3 FY26 compared to 80% in Q3 FY25.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM doubled its store count to 24 operational stores across 12 cities between January 2026 and May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: From January 2026 till now, ORIGEM, Goldiam's India retail lab-grown diamond jewelry brand has doubled its store count, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: Opening an ORIGEM store costs approximately INR 3.5 crores, which includes INR 2.5 crores of inventory investment.
capex_expansion.quote: So per store, approximately it costs INR3.5 crores to open 1 store, INR2.5 crores of which is inventory investment needed in gold, diamond making charges all put together.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam has no immediate plans to expand capex to buy additional diamond growing machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: We believe investing further in these pumps is certainly more ROE accretive than enhancing capex to grow via more machinery for in-house consumption.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam has 8 additional ORIGEM retail stores in the pipeline to be operational by September 30, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores in the pipeline, and they will be operational by September 30, 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam plans to add 12 to 14 Origem stores by March 2026, reaching a total of 24 to 26 operational stores by the end of the fiscal year.
capex_expansion.quote: Goldiam plans to open an additional 12 to 14 Origem stores by March 2026, taking the total store count to about 24 to 26 operational stores by the end of the current fiscal year.

capex_expansion.claim: Setting up an Origem store requires about Rs 1 crore for fit-out costs and rental deposits.
capex_expansion.quote: It is about Rs. 50 to 65 lakhs for the actual fit-out costs of the store, about Rs. 30 to 40 lakhs for rental deposits, so cumulatively about Rs. 1 crore between rental deposit and fit-out costs.

margins_costs.claim: The hybrid casting method in the United States has helped drive margin growth for Goldiam.
margins_costs.quote: At Goldiam on the B2B side, the hybrid casting method where we are casting in the United States has truly been instrumental to help delivering business continuity for ourselves, our customers and in general, in the jewelry industry as well as to help deliver margin growth within the company.

margins_costs.claim: Goldiam expects a 200 to 300 basis point gross margin increment on a full-year basis from dual casting.
margins_costs.quote: It's about between 200 to 300 basis point increment that we are expecting on a full year basis.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached INR 583 million with an EBITDA margin of 23.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q4 2026 at INR583 million grew by 35.9% with EBITDA margin of 23.9%.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA grew by 36.2% to INR 2,486.7 million with an EBITDA margin of 24.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for FY 2026 at INR2,486.7 million grew by 36.2% with EBITDA margin of 24.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Goldiam expects to spend between INR 4 crores to INR 4.5 crores on marketing in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

margins_costs.claim: Goldiam achieved an EBITDA margin of 24.3% in FY26, representing a 155 basis points increase over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA for FY2026 at ₹ 2486.7 million grew by 36.2% with EBITDA margin of 24.3%; an increase of 155 bps over FY2025 EBIDTA margin.

margins_costs.claim: The recent increase in gold customs duty to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations or profitability.
margins_costs.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: Goldiam operates out of the SEEPZ Special Economic Zone and avails applicable customs duty exemptions.
margins_costs.quote: The Company operates from the Special Economic Zone (SEZ)- SEEPZ and continues to avail the applicable customs duty exemptions/benefits available to SEEPZ units under the prevailing government policies and regulations.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated Q3 EBITDA reached Rs 908 million, up 28.2% with a margin of 26.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q3 at Rs. 908 million grew by 28.2% with EBITDA margin of 26.7%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for 9M FY26 grew by 32.7% to Rs 1,853 million with an EBITDA margin of 23.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for 9 months at Rs. 1,853 million grew by 32.7% with EBITDA margin of 23.8%.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as of March 31, 2026, was approximately INR 2,000 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2026, was at about INR2,000 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam operates about 30 diamond growing machines at its SEZ facility.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop.

orders_capacity.claim: In-house production through Eco-Friendly Diamonds accounts for about 10% of Goldiam's lab-grown diamond consumption.
orders_capacity.quote: To share today, Eco-Friendly production is perhaps less -- is about 10% of Goldiam's overall consumption of lab-grown diamonds.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam held an order book position of approximately ₹ 2,000 million as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on March 31, 2026 was at about ₹ 2000 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position stood at approximately Rs 1,800 million as of December 31, 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on December 31st, 2025 was about Rs. 1,800 million.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments stood at INR 4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments were at INR4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 1:3 bonus share issue subject to shareholder approval.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each in proportion of new fully paid up equity share of INR2 for every 3 existing fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each, subject to the approval of shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors proposed issuing bonus shares in a 1:3 ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: The board of directors proposed an issue of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:3

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors declared a first interim dividend of Rs 2.75 per equity share of face value Rs 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to inform that Goldiam has reported strong overall performance and the Board of Directors of the company have declared their first interim dividend at the rate of Rs. 2.75 that is 137.50% per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments stood at Rs 5,041.3 million as of December 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalent including investments were at Rs. 5041.3 million as on December 31st, 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: Goldiam faced business disruptions related to tariffs, Middle East war, and gold price volatility during FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the business disruptions related to tariffs, Middle East war, volatility in gold prices, Goldiam ended FY2026 with a tremendously impressive 27.5% consolidated revenue increase at INR1,212.3 million and a robust 45.7% increase in consolidated PAT at INR1,705.9 million.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in Indian custom duty on gold to 15% will not materially impact Goldiam's operations or profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: ORIGEM recorded an EBITDA level loss of about INR 15 crores for FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: I was saying that I can share that the overall EBITDA level loss at ORIGEM's level was about INR15 crores for the full fiscal year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Goldiam faced business disruptions related to tariffs and the West Asia war during FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the business disruptions related to tariff and West Asia war; Goldiam ended FY2026 with an impressive 27.5% consolidated revenue increase at ₹ 10212.3 million.

risks_headwinds.claim: Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery in the US to address steep US tariff hikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself, providing employment and job opportunities domestically in the US.

risks_headwinds.claim: Origem recorded an operating loss of approximately Rs 2.5 crores during Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, at Origem, we had a loss booked of about 2.5 Cr during Q3 FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The introduction of secondary tariffs caused a temporary operational lag prior to setting up dual casting operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: There was maybe a little bit of lag because the secondary tariffs came into place.
